column1: # How people actually type Marathi in Latin letters, and what they mean by it.
# Two kinds of spelling are here, and neither is reachable from the phonetic
#  - Words the rules get wrong because Latin spelling does not carry the
#    difference: ळ against ल ("shala" is शाळा, "vel" is वेळ), ण against न
#    ("pani" is पाणी, "kon" is कोण), dental against retroflex ("motha" is
#    मोठा), a long vowel nobody doubles ("ahe" is आहे, "khup" is खूप), and
#    the spoken neuter ending nobody writes ("zal" is झालं, "bar" is बरं).
#  - Chat shorthand that drops letters wholesale: "nhi" for नाही, "pn" for
# Words the Marathi rules already spell right (करतो, करणार, त्याला, घराच्या,
# येऊन, मित्र ...) are left out. A hand-written draft of the commonest few
# hundred words; it wants a Marathi speaker's review.
# Format: spelling<TAB>marathi   (one mapping per line; # starts a comment)
# A spelling may repeat to offer several forms, most-preferred first.
# Loaded after en_mr.tsv, so the hand-written loanword spellings win a tie.
